title: Change Log Record
description: Audit record for modifications, creations, deletions, or corrections to CAD entities

description.description: Detailed explanation of what was changed

affected_elements.description: Element IDs affected by the change

before_state.description: Summary of dimensions/positions/attributes prior to change

reason.description: Engineering rationale or user request driving this change

checkpoint_path.description: File path of the pre-change backup DWG if saved
